lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A sparse grid of circular high-luminance clusters arranged in approximately four irregular horizontal rows along the visible mid-section, with a notable increase in spot diameter towards the dorsal ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that cross the horizontal spot rows, creating a subtle grid-like anchor system visible on the posterior third of the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature extending from the mid-body to the caudal peduncle, defined by a high-luminance upper boundary and a sharp vertical shadow gradient transitioning into deep blue-gray below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 8 to 12 distinct, high-intensity circular pixel clusters distributed unevenly across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated in the lower two-thirds of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct linear white mark with high-luminance contrast located on the dorsal surface of the caudal peduncle, immediately anterior to the attachment point of the upper tail fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated dark-pixel silhouettes (commensal fish) visible in the ventral-posterior region and trailing near the pelvic fins.
